image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画北宋「定川寨」（庆历西夏），时间1042 年，宋庆历二年 · 夏天授礼法延祚五年。地点与格局：定川寨、渭州。人物：李元昊（夏国主）、葛怀敏（宋将）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "定川寨" (庆历西夏) in the 北宋 chapter, 1042 年. Place and layout: Dingchuan Fort. Figures: Li Yuanhao, Ge Huaimin. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.narrative: 绍兴十年金军毁约南下。刘锜刚到顺昌，就地筑羊马垣，把船只沉了表示不走。完颜宗弼的重甲骑兵攻城，刘锜在城下设伏，又趁大雨后的暑热出击。金军退走，顺昌保住。这是岳飞北伐同一年里、由另一支军队打的守城战，不能并进朱仙镇的故事里。本场画顺昌的矮墙、城河和城外停住的金军旗帜。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画南宋「顺昌之战」（刘锜），时间1140 年，宋绍兴十年 · 金天眷三年。地点与格局：顺昌。人物：刘锜（宋将）、完颜宗弼（金都元帅）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "顺昌之战" (刘锜) in the 南宋 chapter, 1140 年. Place and layout: Shunchang. Figures: Liu Qi, Wanyan Zongbi. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

music.zh: 配乐以战争为线：战鼓由疏到密，号角拉长，低弦走五声音阶，没有歌词；高潮只一记重鼓，随即收住。本场：南宋「顺昌之战」。
music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "顺昌之战" in 南宋.

scenes.title: 陈家岛
scenes.subtitle: 李宝焚舟

when.era: 宋绍兴三十一年 · 金大定元年

scenes.narrative: 海陵王南侵时，金朝水军从密州一带南下。李宝率宋朝舟师北上，在胶西陈家岛附近发现金船还挂着帆、士兵多不习水。宋军趁风放火，金舟大半被烧，赴海的人很多。这一仗和虞允文的采石几乎同时，一个在黄海之滨，一个在长江。本场只取陈家岛的船队和火，不把采石的陆军混进来，也不画近代舰船。

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画南宋「陈家岛」（李宝焚舟），时间1161 年，宋绍兴三十一年 · 金大定元年。地点与格局：陈家岛、胶西。人物：李宝（宋浙西路马步军副总管）、完颜郑家（金水军统领）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "陈家岛" (李宝焚舟) in the 南宋 chapter, 1161 年. Place and layout: Chenjia Island. Figures: Li Bao, Wanyan Zhengjia. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "陈家岛" in 南宋.

scenes.title: 符离之战
scenes.subtitle: 隆兴北伐

when.era: 宋隆兴元年 · 金大定三年

scenes.narrative: 孝宗起用张浚，想在绍兴和议之后再打一次。李显忠收复宿州，邵宏渊却与他不和，金军反击时宋军在符离崩溃，军资几乎丢光。张浚的北伐就此停住，朝廷重新走向和议。符离的意义是负的：它说明南宋不是没有北伐的意愿，而是前线两将不协、粮械跟不上时，一次胜利会马上变成溃退。本场画符离路上丢弃的旗帜和向南的溃兵剪影。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画南宋「符离之战」（隆兴北伐），时间1163 年，宋隆兴元年 · 金大定三年。地点与格局：符离、宿州。人物：张浚（宋枢密使）、李显忠（宋将）、邵宏渊（宋将）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "符离之战" (隆兴北伐) in the 南宋 chapter, 1163 年. Place and layout: Fuli. Figures: Zhang Jun, Li Xianzhong, Shao Hongyuan. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 野狐岭
scenes.subtitle: 蒙古破金

when.era: 金大安三年 · 宋嘉定四年

scenes.narrative: 成吉思汗在大安三年大举攻金。金军在野狐岭、会河川设防，成吉思汗派木华黎率敢死之士冲击，金军大败，死者被史书写成蔽野。野狐岭是从草原进入华北平原的山口，这一仗之后金朝的北边门户等于被打开，中都开始暴露。西夏、南宋的年号此时并存，本场的纪年以金朝大安三年为准，因为防守的一方是金。

sources.title: 元史
sources.notes: 大安三年破金军于野狐岭

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画辽 · 西夏 · 金「野狐岭」（蒙古破金），时间1211 年，金大安三年 · 宋嘉定四年。地点与格局：野狐岭、会河川。人物：成吉思汗（蒙古大汗）、木华黎（蒙古将）、独吉思忠（金将）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "野狐岭" (蒙古破金) in the 辽 · 西夏 · 金 chapter, 1211 年. Place and layout: Yehuling Pass. Figures: Genghis Khan, Muqali, Duji Sizhong. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画辽 · 西夏 · 金「野狐岭」（蒙古破金），时间1211 年，金大安三年 · 宋嘉定四年。地点与格局：野狐岭、会河川。人物：成吉思汗（蒙古大汗）、木华黎（蒙古将）、独吉思忠（金将）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "野狐岭" (蒙古破金) in the 辽 · 西夏 · 金 chapter, 1211 年. Place and layout: Yehuling Pass. Figures: Genghis Khan, Muqali, Duji Sizhong. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

scenes.title: 丁家洲
scenes.subtitle: 伯颜渡江

when.era: 元至元十二年 · 宋德祐元年

scenes.narrative: 襄阳、樊城陷落后，伯颜沿汉水入江。贾似道被迫督师，在池州下游的丁家洲把舟师排开。元军炮击并冲阵，宋军没怎么接战就溃了，贾似道逃到扬州。长江上的这次崩溃比崖山早四年，它决定的是沿江州郡不再有统一的防线。本场画江面的船阵和岸上扔下的旗，不把崖山的末帝船队提前画出来。

sources.title: 元史

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画元「丁家洲」（伯颜渡江），时间1275 年，元至元十二年 · 宋德祐元年。地点与格局：丁家洲、池州。人物：伯颜（元丞相）、贾似道（宋右丞相）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "丁家洲" (伯颜渡江) in the 元 chapter, 1275 年. Place and layout: Dingjiazhou. Figures: Bayan, Jia Sidao. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.narrative: 建文二年，李景隆率号称百万的南军北上，与燕王朱棣在白沟河相遇。南军在数量上占优，燕军一度被压到绝境，朱棣几乎陷在阵里。风向一转，南军大火烧营，李景隆连夜逃回德州。这一仗不是金川门那场不战而降，而是靖难里少有的大规模野战。本场只取白沟河的夜火和两军旗帜，不把后来的“诛十族”写进同一画面。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画明「白沟河」（靖难前哨），时间1400 年，明建文二年。地点与格局：白沟河。人物：朱棣（燕王）、李景隆（大将军）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "白沟河" (靖难前哨) in the 明 chapter, 1400 年. Place and layout: Baigou River. Figures: Zhu Di, Li Jinglong. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "白沟河" (靖难前哨) in the 明 chapter, 1400 年. Place and layout: Baigou River. music.zh: 配乐以战争为线：战鼓由疏到密，号角拉长，低弦走五声音阶，没有歌词；高潮只一记重鼓，随即收住。本场：明「白沟河」。
music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "白沟河" in 明.

scenes.title: 平壤之战
scenes.subtitle: 李如松援朝
scenes.narrative: 万历朝鲜之役里，日军占领平壤。万历二十一年正月，李如松督明军攻城，用大炮轰开城门一带，日军退向汉城。明军入城后抢掠，李如松斩了自己的部下压住。这是明军在朝鲜打的一次真正的攻城，和后来碧蹄馆的受挫不是同一天。本场画冬日的平壤城墙和城门上的烟，画面里不出现近代枪械的特写，火器只作为城头的烟。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画明「平壤之战」（李如松援朝），时间1593 年，明万历二十一年。地点与格局：平壤。人物：李如松（明提督）、小西行长（日军将领）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画明「平壤之战」（李如松援朝），时间1593 年，明万历二十一年。地点与格局：平壤。人物：李如松（明提督）、小西行长（日军将领）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "平壤之战" (李如松援朝) in the 明 chapter, 1593 年. Place and layout: Pyongyang. Figures: Li Rusong, Konishi Yukinaga. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "平壤之战" (李如松援朝) in the 明 chapter, 1593 年. Place and layout: Pyongyang. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

scenes.title: 松锦之战
scenes.subtitle: 洪承畴

when.era: 明崇祯十三年至十五年
when.notes: start 取围城之始；城破与洪承畴降在崇祯十五年。

scenes.narrative: 清军围锦州，明廷派洪承畴出山海关救援。他起初主守，朝里催促进战，明军集结在松山。皇太极切断粮道之后，明军夜溃，洪承畴被困在松山，次年城破被俘，祖大寿也开锦州出降。松锦之后，明朝在关外只剩下宁远等少数孤城。本场和袁崇焕的宁远守城分开：那是天启的胜仗，这是崇祯的大败。画面取长围、粮道和关外的雪。

sources.title: 明史
sources.notes: 崇祯十五年松山陷，洪承畴降

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画明「松锦之战」（洪承畴），时间1640—1642 年，明崇祯十三年至十五年。地点与格局：松山、锦州。人物：洪承畴（明蓟辽总督）、皇太极（清太宗）、祖大寿（明总兵）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "松锦之战" (洪承畴) in the 明 chapter, 1640—1642 年. Place and layout: Songshan and Jinzhou. Figures: Hong Chengchou, Hong Taiji, Zu Dashou. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画明「松锦之战」（洪承畴），时间1640—1642 年，明崇祯十三年至十五年。地点与格局：松山、锦州。人物：洪承畴（明蓟辽总督）、皇太极（清太宗）、祖大寿（明总兵）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "松锦之战" (洪承畴) in the 明 chapter, 1640—1642 年. Place and layout: Songshan and Jinzhou. Figures: Hong Chengchou, Hong Taiji, Zu Dashou. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

scenes.title: 雅克萨
scenes.subtitle: 两次围城

when.era: 清康熙二十四年至二十五年
when.notes: 康熙二十四年取城，二十五年俄军复至，再次围城后议和。

scenes.narrative: 俄罗斯人在雅克萨筑城，清廷先致书，不成，康熙二十四年派彭春、萨布素等水陆并进，攻下城后平毁，允许俄人退走。第二年俄军又回来筑城，清军再围。双方最后在尼布楚谈界。本场只写这两次围城，不把康熙二十八年的条约文本放进画面——划界已有专场可走。画面是黑龙江上的木城、船只和城外的营垒。

sources.title: 清史稿
sources.notes: 康熙二十四年攻雅克萨，二十五年复围

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画清「雅克萨」（两次围城），时间1685—1686 年，清康熙二十四年至二十五年。地点与格局：雅克萨、黑龙江。人物：萨布素（清黑龙江将军）、彭春（清都统）、托尔布津（俄军头目）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "雅克萨" (两次围城) in the 清 chapter, 1685—1686 年. Place and layout: Albazin on the Amur. Figures: Sabsu, Pengcun, Afanasy Tolbuzin. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画清「雅克萨」（两次围城），时间1685—1686 年，清康熙二十四年至二十五年。地点与格局：雅克萨、黑龙江。人物：萨布素（清黑龙江将军）、彭春（清都统）、托尔布津（俄军头目）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "雅克萨" (两次围城) in the 清 chapter, 1685—1686 年. Place and layout: Albazin on the Amur. Figures: Sabsu, Pengcun, Afanasy Tolbuzin. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 昭莫多
scenes.subtitle: 费扬古
scenes.narrative: 康熙亲征噶尔丹，自己率中路出草原，西路费扬古拦在昭莫多。噶尔丹的军队从土拉河来，费扬古先据山，用下马步战拖住，再以骑兵袭其后营。噶尔丹丢掉辎重逃走，阿奴等人战死。昭莫多是乌兰布通之后真正把噶尔丹从漠北打散的一仗。本场画山梁上的下马军阵和河湾，康熙的御营放在远处，不画近代地图的经纬线。

sources.title: 清史稿
sources.notes: 康熙三十五年昭莫多之战

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画清「昭莫多」（费扬古），时间1696 年，清康熙三十五年。地点与格局：昭莫多、土拉河。人物：费扬古（清抚远大将军）、噶尔丹（准噶尔汗）、康熙帝（清帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "昭莫多" (费扬古) in the 清 chapter, 1696 年. Place and layout: Zuunmod and the Tuul. Figures: Fiyanggū, Galdan, Kangxi Emperor. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

scenes.title: 平壤陆战
scenes.subtitle: 左宝贵
scenes.narrative: 甲午年日本陆军进逼平壤。清军叶志超主退，总兵左宝贵坚持守北城，穿上朝服登城指挥，在玄武门中炮而死。叶志超随即弃城。这是黄海海战之外、陆地上决定朝鲜战局的一仗。《清史稿·左宝贵传》写了他的死，《德宗本纪》写了平壤溃。本场画平壤北城的城楼和一面还在的旗帜，不画近代步枪的特写，炮烟只作为城头的一团墨。

sources.title: 清史稿
sources.notes: 光绪二十年守平壤玄武门，中炮死

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画清「平壤陆战」（左宝贵），时间1894 年，清光绪二十年。地点与格局：平壤、玄武门。人物：左宝贵（清总兵）、叶志超（清总统）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "平壤陆战" (左宝贵) in the 清 chapter, 1894 年. Place and layout: Pyongyang, North Gate. Figures: Zuo Baogui, Ye Zhichao. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 皋陶作士
scenes.subtitle: 刑的源头

when.notes: 皋陶的年代属于传说，公元年只用于排在禹之前。

scenes.narrative: 《史记·五帝本纪》说舜任用皋陶作士，主管五刑。《尚书·舜典》也把“五刑有服”系在皋陶名下。这不是一部传下来的法典，而是上古叙事里“刑罚要有专人、不能由征服者随口决定”的起点。后世把法律之祖追到他身上，正史能证实的只有这个官职和这套说法。本场画一座空的士师席和几条墨线似的刑具轮廓，不画后来的衙门。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画上古「皋陶作士」（刑的源头），时间传说时代，虞舜之时（年号未行）。地点与格局：虞廷。人物：皋陶（士）、舜（部族首领）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "皋陶作士" (刑的源头) in the 上古 chapter, 传说时代. Place and layout: the court of Shun. Figures: Gao Yao, Shun. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 太康失国
scenes.subtitle: 羿距之于河

when.notes: 夏王世次的公元年都是约数。

scenes.narrative: 启之后，太康游猎无度，有穷氏后羿把他挡在黄河以北，不让他回国。《史记·夏本纪》用很短的句子写下“失国”，《尚书·五子之歌》是后来的训诫文本，细节不可当实录。这件事的政治含义很清楚：家天下刚建立，国君离开都城和军队，位子就可以被别人占住。本场取河岸和回不去的车仗，不取后羿射日的神话——那是另一套传说。

sources.title: 尚书
sources.notes: 太康失邦，后人追述，不当实录

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画夏「太康失国」（羿距之于河），时间约前 2000 年，夏太康时（年号未行）。地点与格局：黄河。人物：太康（夏后）、后羿（有穷氏）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "太康失国" (羿距之于河) in the 夏 chapter, 约前 2000 年. Place and layout: the Yellow River. Figures: Taikang, Houyi. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 微子去殷
scenes.subtitle: 三仁之一

when.notes: 在牧野之前，精确年份不可考。

scenes.narrative: 微子是纣的庶兄。他看见殷商的祭祀和刑政都乱了，和太师、少师商量之后离开。《史记·宋微子世家》把他的出走写成对宗庙的保存，而不是叛变。比干死谏、箕子装狂，是另外两条路，已有“殷有三仁”一场。本场只写微子出走这一条：一个宗室离开都城，后来才被周封在宋。治国篇看的是“宗庙由谁带走”，不是牧野的战阵。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画商「微子去殷」（三仁之一），时间约前 1048 年，商纣末年（年号未行）。地点与格局：殷墟。人物：微子启（殷宗室）、纣（商王）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "微子去殷" (三仁之一) in the 商 chapter, 约前 1048 年. Place and layout: Yin. Figures: Weizi Qi, Zhou of Shang. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 制礼作乐
scenes.subtitle: 周公

when.notes: 与周公摄政、东征大致同时，年份取成王初。

scenes.narrative: 周公东征是一场战争，已有专场。另一件事是他给新建的周朝补制度：《史记·周本纪》和《鲁周公世家》都说他制礼作乐，相成王。《尚书·洛诰》写的是营建洛邑时的对话，不是一部礼仪手册。能站住的是：周人用祭礼、嫡长和分封把征服写成秩序。本场画洛邑的空庭和成排的礼器剪影，不把汉代画像砖上的周公辅成王当成周初写真。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画西周「制礼作乐」（周公），时间约前 1042 年，周成王初年（年号未行）。地点与格局：洛邑。人物：周公旦（周王室）、周成王（周天子）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "制礼作乐" (周公) in the 西周 chapter, 约前 1042 年. Place and layout: Luoyi. Figures: Duke of Zhou, King Cheng of Zhou. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "制礼作乐" (周公) in the 西周 chapter, 约前 1042 年. Place and layout: Luoyi. Image-to-video shows sleeves stirring in court, an ink line slowly extending across a map of reforms, granaries and canal water nearly still, then a slow push into a freeze-frame. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

scenes.title: 不籍千亩
scenes.subtitle: 虢文公之谏

when.notes: 《国语》系于宣王即位，不系于三十九年的千亩之战。

scenes.narrative: 宣王一即位，就不按旧例举行籍田。虢文公劝他：籍田是劝农的仪式，王亲自推耜，百姓才跟着种。宣王不听。《国语·周语》把这件事放在千亩战败之前，当成后来“丧南国之师”的远因。它不是一场仗，是一项被放弃的国家仪式。本场和“千亩之战”分开：这里只有田亩、耜和空着的王者位置。

scenes.title: 参国伍鄙
scenes.subtitle: 管仲内政

when.notes: 管仲相齐的具体月份不可考，取桓公即位之年。

scenes.narrative: 齐桓公称霸是军事和盟会，已有专场。管仲真正先做的是国内的编制：《国语·齐语》写他用参国伍鄙把士、农、工、商分开居住，军赋就从这些编制里出。《史记·管晏列传》更强调他与鲍叔的私谊，内政的细节要看《齐语》。这是春秋时代少有的、被写成制度而不是只写成战役的改革。本场画都城外分片的聚落，不画后来的葵丘之会。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画春秋「参国伍鄙」（管仲内政），时间约前 685 年，齐桓公初年（年号未行）。地点与格局：临淄。人物：管仲（齐相）、齐桓公（齐君）、鲍叔牙（齐大夫）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "参国伍鄙" (管仲内政) in the 春秋 chapter, 约前 685 年. Place and layout: Linzi. Figures: Guan Zhong, Duke Huan of Qi, Bao Shuya. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画春秋「参国伍鄙」（管仲内政），时间约前 685 年，齐桓公初年（年号未行）。地点与格局：临淄。人物：管仲（齐相）、齐桓公（齐君）、鲍叔牙（齐大夫）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "参国伍鄙" (管仲内政) in the 春秋 chapter, 约前 685 年. Place and layout: Linzi. Figures: Guan Zhong, Duke Huan of Qi, Bao Shuya. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 弭兵之会
scenes.subtitle: 向戌

when.era: 周灵王二十六年 · 鲁襄公二十七年（年号未行）

scenes.narrative: 宋国向戌在晋楚之间奔走，襄公二十七年把双方和十几个小国请到宋都会盟，约定停止正面大战。盟书写了“晋楚之从交相见”，小国要同时讨好两边，负担并没有消失。《左传》也记下盟会上楚人裹甲，信任很薄。这不是和平条约的现代文本，是一次用会盟把霸战按下去的尝试。本场画宋都的坛和两边的空车，不画鄢陵那种战阵。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画春秋「弭兵之会」（向戌），时间前 546 年，周灵王二十六年 · 鲁襄公二十七年（年号未行）。地点与格局：宋。人物：向戌（宋大夫）、赵武（晋卿）、屈建（楚令尹）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "弭兵之会" (向戌) in the 春秋 chapter, 前 546 年. Place and layout: Song. scenes.title: 堕三都
scenes.subtitle: 孔子与三桓

when.era: 周敬王二十二年 · 鲁定公十二年（年号未行）

scenes.narrative: 鲁国三桓的私家城邑大过公家。孔子在定公时代建议堕三都：拆掉叔孙氏的郈、季孙氏的费。郈拆了，费邑的公山不狃反抗，定公和季桓子被围，孔子派申句须、乐颀才把费打下来。成邑却因为孟孙氏的抵制没有拆成。《左传》把这件事写成国君想收回城防，不是单纯的道德故事。本场画三座城、拆到一半的墙。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画春秋「堕三都」（孔子与三桓），时间前 498 年，周敬王二十二年 · 鲁定公十二年（年号未行）。地点与格局：郈、费、成。人物：孔子（鲁大司寇）、季桓子（鲁卿）、公山不狃（费宰）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "堕三都" (孔子与三桓) in the 春秋 chapter, 前 498 年. Place and layout: Hou, Bi and Cheng. Figures: Confucius, Ji Huanzi, Gongshan Buniu. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 烹阿大夫
scenes.subtitle: 齐威王

when.notes: 《史记》系于威王初即位之后，没有精确到某月。

scenes.narrative: 齐威王即位初期，政事委托卿大夫，国家很弱。他召即墨大夫，说毁谤你的话每天都有，我派人去看，田野开辟、百姓富足，是你不巴结左右。又召阿大夫，说夸你的话每天都有，派人去看却是田坏民冻。于是烹阿大夫和左右曾经吹捧他的人。这是战国治国叙事里最狠的一则赏罚，出自《史记·田敬仲完世家》。本场只画朝堂和两份相反的报告，不画行刑的血。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画战国「烹阿大夫」（齐威王），时间约前 356 年，齐威王初年（年号未行）。地点与格局：临淄、即墨、阿。人物：齐威王（齐君）、即墨大夫（齐地方官）、阿大夫（齐地方官）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "烹阿大夫" (齐威王) in the 战国 chapter, 约前 356 年. Place and layout: Linzi, Jimo and E. Figures: King Wei of Qi, the governor of Jimo, the governor of E. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 尽地力
scenes.subtitle: 李悝

when.notes: 李悝为魏文侯作法经、尽地力，年份只能取文侯中期。

scenes.narrative: 魏文侯用李悝。汉代人追述他说李悝作尽地力之教，鼓励农耕，又以平籴在丰年收购、荒年抛出，还编过《法经》六篇。这些话主要保存在《汉书·食货志》和《晋书·刑法志》，不是魏国当时的原档。能采纳的是：战国变法不是从商鞅才开始，魏国更早把土地和刑律当成国家工程。本场画井田式的墨线和一册刑书，并注明法经原文已佚。

sources.title: 汉书
sources.notes: 李悝为魏文侯作尽地力之教

sources.title: 晋书

scenes.title: 谤木
scenes.subtitle: 邹忌
scenes.narrative: 邹忌用自己和城北徐公比美的事劝齐威王：宫里的人、朝里的臣、国内的人都因为私心说他美。威王于是下令，能当面指出过失的受上赏，上书的受中赏，在市朝议论而被听到的受下赏。这是《战国策·齐策》的名篇，《史记·田敬仲完世家》也收了大意。它是一则关于信息如何进到国君耳朵里的故事，不是法令全文。本场画朝门和一群来进言的剪影。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画战国「谤木」（邹忌），时间约前 4 世纪中叶，齐威王时（年号未行）。地点与格局：临淄。人物：邹忌（齐相）、齐威王（齐君）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "谤木" (邹忌) in the 战国 chapter, 约前 4 世纪中叶. Place and layout: Linzi. Figures: Zou Ji, King Wei of Qi. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

Image-to-video shows sleeves stirring in court, an ink line slowly extending across a map of reforms, granaries and canal water nearly still, then a slow push into a freeze-frame. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "谤木" (邹忌) in the 战国 chapter, 约前 4 世纪中叶. Place and layout: Linzi. scenes.title: 廷议分封
scenes.subtitle: 李斯驳王绾
scenes.narrative: 秦刚统一，丞相王绾请封诸子到燕、齐、楚的故地，说不封建就管不住这么远。李斯反对：周朝分封，诸侯相攻就像仇人，天下才重新打起来。始皇采纳李斯，分天下为郡，郡下设县。这是《史记·秦始皇本纪》里一次真正决定国家形状的朝议。“书同文”是配套的另一项，已有专场。本场只画殿上的两派和地图，不画长城工地。

sources.title: 史记

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画秦「廷议分封」（李斯驳王绾），时间前 221 年，秦始皇二十六年。地点与格局：咸阳。人物：秦始皇（秦帝）、李斯（廷尉）、王绾（丞相）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "廷议分封" (李斯驳王绾) in the 秦 chapter, 前 221 年. Place and layout: Xianyang. Figures: Qin Shi Huang, Li Si, Wang Wan. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 治安策
scenes.subtitle: 贾谊

when.era: 汉文帝前元六年（年号未行）
when.notes: 文帝元年为前 179 年。贾谊卒于前 169 年前后，策在此前。

scenes.narrative: 贾谊在长沙和梁国之间上疏，核心是诸侯王的封地太大，中央要用“众建诸侯而少其力”把它们拆小，同时改礼服、定等次。《汉书·贾谊传》保存了长篇，宣室夜问鬼神是另一场面，已有专场。本场只取他对王国问题的判断：不在朝堂上把封地拆开，将来就是又一次七国之乱。文帝没有全盘照做，但后来晁错、主父偃走的是同一条思路。

sources.title: 汉书
sources.notes: 陈治安之策，请众建诸侯而少其力

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画楚汉 · 西汉「治安策」（贾谊），时间前 174 年，汉文帝前元六年（年号未行）。地点与格局：长安。人物：贾谊（梁王太傅）、汉文帝（汉帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "治安策" (贾谊) in the 楚汉 · 西汉 chapter, 前 174 年. Place and layout: Chang'an. Figures: Jia Yi, Emperor Wen of Han. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 推恩令
scenes.subtitle: 主父偃
scenes.narrative: 晁错削藩引发七国之乱。元朔二年，主父偃换了一个办法：诸侯王可以把封地分给所有子弟，由朝廷定名号。王国越分越小，不用再下削地的诏书。《史记·主父偃列传》说武帝立刻施行。这是西汉治国里最成功的一次制度手术，它和同一年卫青收河南地同时发生，但一件在朝堂，一件在边塞。本场只画被分成小块的封国地图。

scenes.title: 盐铁之议
scenes.subtitle: 贤良文学
scenes.narrative: 武帝死后，盐铁官营还在。始元六年，昭帝叫郡国举的贤良文学进长安，和御史大夫桑弘羊辩论要不要罢掉盐铁、均输。桓宽后来把这次辩论写成《盐铁论》，那是整理过的文本，不是当场的速记。《汉书·车千秋传》证实会议开过，并在次年罢了酒酤。本场取朝堂上的两排人：一边要边费和国库，一边要民间的铁器。不把《盐铁论》的每一句都当成原话。

sources.title: 汉书
sources.notes: 始元六年诏贤良文学议罢盐铁

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画楚汉 · 西汉「盐铁之议」（贤良文学），时间前 81 年，汉昭帝始元六年。地点与格局：长安。人物：桑弘羊（御史大夫）、贤良文学（与会者）、汉昭帝（汉帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. Figures: Sang Hongyang, the literati, Emperor Zhao of Han. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 屯田奏
scenes.subtitle: 赵充国
scenes.narrative: 神爵元年，西羌反。赵充国在金城主张罢骑兵、留步兵在湟中屯田，上了三份奏，反复和朝里主战的人争。宣帝最终允许他留兵开垦，羌人后来分化。《汉书·赵充国传》把奏文保存得很完整，是西汉少见的、把军费算成粮食账的文件。本场画湟水边的营田和奏牍，不画陈汤那种千里突袭。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画楚汉 · 西汉「屯田奏」（赵充国），时间前 60 年，汉宣帝神爵元年。地点与格局：湟中、金城。人物：赵充国（后将军）、汉宣帝（汉帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "屯田奏" (赵充国) in the 楚汉 · 西汉 chapter, 前 60 年. Place and layout: Huangzhong. Figures: Zhao Chongguo, Emperor Xuan of Han. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画楚汉 · 西汉「屯田奏」（赵充国），时间前 60 年，汉宣帝神爵元年。地点与格局：湟中、金城。人物：赵充国（后将军）、汉宣帝（汉帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "屯田奏" (赵充国) in the 楚汉 · 西汉 chapter, 前 60 年. Place and layout: Huangzhong. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. scenes.title: 度田
scenes.subtitle: 光武检核
scenes.narrative: 建武十五年，光武帝下令各州郡核实垦田和户口。地方官包庇豪强，把赋转到贫户头上，百姓起来反抗，有的郡守因为度田不实被下狱。《后汉书·光武帝纪》和《刘隆传》都写了这次清查的反弹。它说明东汉开国不久就碰到土地账和豪强的冲突，不是只在末年才有。本场画田册和郡守手中的简，不画昆阳的雷雨。

sources.title: 后汉书
sources.notes: 建武十五年诏下州郡检核垦田户口

scenes.title: 邓太后称制
scenes.subtitle: 元兴之后
scenes.narrative: 和帝死，邓绥立出生才百日的殇帝，自己临朝。殇帝一年后死，她又立安帝，继续称制，前后十余年。她限制外戚邓氏的一部分特权，也用宦官，史书对她的评价比对后来的梁冀温和，但权力结构是一样的：皇帝幼小，太后和兄弟掌机要。《后汉书·皇后纪》是这一段的主要文本。本场画空着的御座和太后的帘，不把她写成后来的慈禧。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画新 · 东汉「邓太后称制」（元兴之后），时间106 年，汉殇帝延平元年。地点与格局：洛阳。人物：邓绥（和熹邓太后）、汉安帝（汉帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "邓太后称制" (元兴之后) in the 新 · 东汉 chapter, 106 年. Place and layout: Luoyang. Figures: Deng Sui, Emperor An of Han. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画新 · 东汉「邓太后称制」（元兴之后），时间106 年，汉殇帝延平元年。地点与格局：洛阳。人物：邓绥（和熹邓太后）、汉安帝（汉帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "邓太后称制" (元兴之后) in the 新 · 东汉 chapter, 106 年. Place and layout: Luoyang. Figures: Deng Sui, Emperor An of Han. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 许下屯田
scenes.subtitle: 枣祗
scenes.narrative: 建安元年曹操迎献帝到许，同时采纳枣祗、韩浩的办法，在许下屯田，用官牛收租。一年得谷百万斛，后来推广到各州郡。《三国志·武帝纪》和《任峻传》都把这件事写成曹氏能支撑长期战争的原因。它是治国，不是官渡的夜袭：先有粮，才有后来的仗。本场画许县郊外的屯田和粮堆，不画官渡的火。

sources.title: 三国志
sources.notes: 建安元年用枣祗、韩浩等议，始兴屯田

sources.title: 三国志
sources.notes: 军国之饶，起于枣祗而成于峻

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画三国「许下屯田」（枣祗），时间196 年，汉建安元年。地点与格局：许。人物：曹操（汉司空）、枣祗（屯田都尉）、任峻（典农中郎将）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "许下屯田" (枣祗) in the 三国 chapter, 196 年. Place and layout: Xu. video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画三国「许下屯田」（枣祗），时间196 年，汉建安元年。地点与格局：许。人物：曹操（汉司空）、枣祗（屯田都尉）、任峻（典农中郎将）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频只拍朝会里衣袖轻动、地图上的墨线缓缓延伸、仓廪与渠水几乎静止，镜头缓推后定格。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "许下屯田" (枣祗) in the 三国 chapter, 196 年. Place and layout: Xu. Figures: Cao Cao, Zao Zhi, Ren Jun. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video shows sleeves stirring in court, an ink line slowly extending across a map of reforms, granaries and canal water nearly still, then a slow push into a freeze-frame. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

scenes.title: 九品官人
scenes.subtitle: 陈群

when.era: 魏延康元年 / 黄初元年

scenes.narrative: 曹丕代汉这一年，陈群建议用九品官人法：郡设中正，把本地人物分成九等，供吏部选用。起初是为了在战乱里找到人，后来中正被大族把持，变成门第的工具。这个后果是两晋人的批评，《三国志·陈群传》只记下创立本身。本场取延康年间的朝议，不把后来“上品无寒门”的成语当成曹丕当年的原文。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画三国「九品官人」（陈群），时间220 年，魏延康元年 / 黄初元年。地点与格局：洛阳。人物：陈群（尚书）、曹丕（魏王）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "九品官人" (陈群) in the 三国 chapter, 220 年. Place and layout: Luoyang. Figures: Chen Qun, Cao Pi. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 科教严明
scenes.subtitle: 诸葛亮治蜀
scenes.narrative: 刘备死后，诸葛亮开府治蜀。陈寿在《三国志》本传的评语里说他科教严明、赏罚必信，官吏不敢欺，百姓都记得他。同时也说他连年兴军，没有做到以攻为守之外的休息。治国篇取前一半：南征和北伐是别的场，这里只写成都的府寺、条文和他亲自校对的簿书。不把《出师表》的每一个句子都搬上画面。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画三国「科教严明」（诸葛亮治蜀），时间223 年，蜀建兴元年。地点与格局：成都。人物：诸葛亮（蜀丞相）、刘禅（蜀帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "科教严明" (诸葛亮治蜀) in the 三国 chapter, 223 年. Place and layout: Chengdu. Figures: Zhuge Liang, Liu Shan. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画三国「科教严明」（诸葛亮治蜀），时间223 年，蜀建兴元年。地点与格局：成都。人物：诸葛亮（蜀丞相）、刘禅（蜀帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频跟着这个人：衣袖与冠带轻摆，或独坐、或对坐、或踏上远路，镜头缓推，保持同一剪影，不新增人物。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "科教严明" (诸葛亮治蜀) in the 三国 chapter, 223 年. Place and layout: Chengdu. Figures: Zhuge Liang, Liu Shan. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video follows this one figure: sleeves and hat-strings stirring, sitting alone or facing another, or setting out on a road. A slow push. Keep the same silhouette. No new figures. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

scenes.title: 户调式
scenes.subtitle: 太康均田亩
scenes.narrative: 平吴这一年，晋朝颁布户调之式：丁男之户每年交绢三匹、绵三斤，女及次丁减半，并按官品占田。《晋书·食货志》保存了这个框架。它常常被和北魏均田令比，但晋的占田是限额和课税，不是把无主地授给每户。本场按《食货志》的原意画户籍和绢，不把太和均田的名词提前用到晋武帝身上。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画两晋「户调式」（太康均田亩），时间280 年，晋武帝太康元年。地点与格局：洛阳。人物：晋武帝（晋帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "户调式" (太康均田亩) in the 两晋 chapter, 280 年. Place and layout: Luoyang. Figures: Emperor Wu of Jin. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 庚戌土断
scenes.subtitle: 桓温
scenes.narrative: 南渡的北方人长期挂着侨州郡的籍，不入当地户籍，赋役就转不到他们头上。兴宁二年三月庚戌，桓温行土断，把侨人断入所居郡县的户籍，王公以下都不得例外，会稽王司马昱也受了罚。《晋书·桓温传》把庚戌土断写成他内政里最有实效的一项。本场画江南的户籍册和被涂掉的侨郡名，不画北伐的战船。

sources.title: 晋书
sources.notes: 兴宁二年三月庚戌，大阅户人，严法禁

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画两晋「庚戌土断」（桓温），时间364 年，东晋兴宁二年。地点与格局：建康。人物：桓温（大司马）、司马昱（会稽王）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "庚戌土断" (桓温) in the 两晋 chapter, 364 年. Place and layout: Jiankang. Figures: Huan Wen, Sima Yu. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 均田令
scenes.subtitle: 太和九年
scenes.narrative: 太和九年，北魏下诏均田：十五岁以上的男夫受露田四十亩，妇人二十亩，奴婢依良人，另有桑田。土地在年老或身死后还官，桑田可以留。《魏书·食货志》记录了这个框架。它是鲜卑政权在中原用汉地的亩制重新把劳动力绑到土地上。和太和十年的三长制是一套改革的两步，本场只写授田的文书，三长另场。

sources.title: 魏书
sources.notes: 太和九年十月丁未，诏均给天下民田

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画南北朝「均田令」（太和九年），时间485 年，北魏太和九年。地点与格局：平城。人物：冯太后（临朝称制）、北魏孝文帝（魏帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "均田令" (太和九年) in the 南北朝 chapter, 485 年. Place and layout: Pingcheng. Figures: Empress Dowager Feng, Emperor Xiaowen. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画南北朝「均田令」（太和九年），时间485 年，北魏太和九年。地点与格局：平城。人物：冯太后（临朝称制）、北魏孝文帝（魏帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "均田令" (太和九年) in the 南北朝 chapter, 485 年. Place and layout: Pingcheng. Figures: Empress Dowager Feng, Emperor Xiaowen. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

scenes.title: 三长制
scenes.subtitle: 废宗主督护
scenes.narrative: 均田的第二年，李冲建议设三长：五家一邻长，五邻一里长，五里一党长，用来代替豪强包揽户口的宗主督护。文明太后在朝议里压下反对，下令施行。《魏书·食货志》和《李冲传》都写了争论。没有三长，均田的账就仍然在宗主手里。本场画邻、里、党的三级名籍，不和迁都洛阳混成一件事——迁都在太和十七年之后。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画南北朝「三长制」（废宗主督护），时间486 年，北魏太和十年。地点与格局：平城。人物：李冲（内秘书令）、冯太后（临朝称制）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "三长制" (废宗主督护) in the 南北朝 chapter, 486 年. Place and layout: Pingcheng. Figures: Li Chong, Empress Dowager Feng. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 开皇律
scenes.subtitle: 除枭辕
scenes.narrative: 杨坚代周的当年就命高颎、郑译、杨素等人更定新律，第二年又让苏威、牛弘改定。开皇律把死罪条款减少，废除枭首、辕身等法，定下五刑和十恶的框架。《隋书·刑法志》是主要依据。它直接影响后来的唐律。本场和“临光殿受禅”分开：受禅是权力转移，开皇律是他们拿到权力之后写的规则。画面是竹简和朱笔，不是宫殿典礼。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画隋「开皇律」（除枭辕），时间581 年，隋开皇元年。地点与格局：大兴。人物：隋文帝（隋帝）、高颎（尚书左仆射）、苏威（纳言）、牛弘（礼部尚书）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "开皇律" (除枭辕) in the 隋 chapter, 581 年. Place and layout: Daxing. Figures: Emperor Wen of Sui, Gao Jiong, Su Wei, Niu Hong. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 岁贡三人
scenes.subtitle: 开皇科举的前身
scenes.narrative: 开皇七年，隋文帝命诸州每年贡士三人。《隋书·高祖纪》有这条诏令。进士科是不是炀帝大业年间才有，两唐书和通典的说法并不一致，本场不把“隋创进士”写成定论，只写开皇这条还能在正史纪里对上的岁贡。它的意义是：选人开始从州里往上送，不完全靠中正的品状。本场画州府的贡士名单，不画唐代的贡院号舍。

sources.title: 隋书
sources.notes: 开皇七年命诸州岁贡三人

sources.title: 隋书
sources.notes: 开皇之间征辟与贡士，进士科始年诸书不一

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画隋「岁贡三人」（开皇科举的前身），时间587 年，隋开皇七年。地点与格局：大兴。人物：隋文帝（隋帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "岁贡三人" (开皇科举的前身) in the 隋 chapter, 587 年. Place and layout: Daxing. Figures: Emperor Wen of Sui. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 租庸调
scenes.subtitle: 武德七年
scenes.narrative: 武德七年，唐朝把租、庸、调写进令：每丁租粟二石，调绢或布，庸是力役，不想服役可以用绢代替。《旧唐书·食货志》和《唐会要》都记了这个框架。它是建立在均田和户籍之上的，所以安禄山之后户口大乱，这套税法就收不上来。本场只写武德的令文和户籍，两税法是德宗时的另一场。

sources.title: 旧唐书
