video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画唐「租庸调」（武德七年），时间624 年，唐武德七年。地点与格局：长安。人物：唐高祖（唐帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频只拍朝会里衣袖轻动、地图上的墨线缓缓延伸、仓廪与渠水几乎静止，镜头缓推后定格。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "租庸调" (武德七年) in the 唐 chapter, 624 年. Place and layout: Chang'an. Figures: Emperor Gaozu of Tang. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video shows sleeves stirring in court, an ink line slowly extending across a map of reforms, granaries and canal water nearly still, then a slow push into a freeze-frame. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

scenes.title: 贞观斗米
scenes.subtitle: 外户不闭
scenes.narrative: 贞观四年，唐军破东突厥，北边暂时安静。旧唐书说这一年天下判死罪的只有二十九人，东至于海、南至于岭，外户不闭，行旅不带粮食。这些句子是史官的颂词，不能当成逐县统计，但它们被写进本纪，代表唐人对贞观治理的标准画像。魏征进谏已有专场。本场只取年成、刑狱和路上的空门，不把颂词画成永远的太平。

sources.title: 旧唐书
sources.notes: 贞观四年，米斗不过三四钱，外户不闭

sources.title: 资治通鉴
sources.notes: 贞观四年治象，与旧唐书互见

Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.narrative: 建中元年，杨炎建议废租庸调，按户等和田亩在夏、秋两次收税，不分主户客户，商人也要纳税。德宗采纳。旧唐书说这是因为版籍坏了，丁额已经查不清。《旧唐书·杨炎传》和《食货志》是依据。两税后来被附加税掏空，但征税的单位从“丁”改成“资产”，是中古财政的转轴。本场画夏秋两册税簿。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画唐「两税法」（杨炎），时间780 年，唐德宗建中元年。地点与格局：长安。人物：杨炎（宰相）、唐德宗（唐帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "两税法" (杨炎) in the 唐 chapter, 780 年. Place and layout: Chang'an. Figures: Yang Yan, Emperor Dezong. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "两税法" (杨炎) in the 唐 chapter, 780 年. Place and layout: Chang'an. Image-to-video shows sleeves stirring in court, an ink line slowly extending across a map of reforms, granaries and canal water nearly still, then a slow push into a freeze-frame. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

music.zh: 配乐庄严，近于朝会：编钟与古琴，缓慢，五声音阶，没有歌词，不要战鼓喧哗。本场：唐「两税法」。
music.en: Music is solemn and courtly: bells and qin, slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no battlefield drums. This cue: "两税法" in 唐.

sound.zh: 声响以朝局为线：殿中回声、竹简展开、脚步在砖地上、远处市声。不要金戈与喊杀。本场地点：长安。
sound.en: Sound follows the court: hall reverb, bamboo slips unrolling, footsteps on brick, a distant market. No clash of arms, no war cries. Place for this cue: Chang'an.

scenes.title: 永贞革新
scenes.subtitle: 二王八司马
scenes.narrative: 顺宗在永贞元年正月即位，说话已经困难，王叔文、王伾引用柳宗元、刘禹锡等，罢宫市、停进奉，并想从宦官手里收回兵权。八月顺宗退位，宪宗即位，王叔文被贬，随后赐死，八名官员贬到远州。旧唐书把这场变革写成小人专权，宋人以后也有不同评价。本场只记录措施和结局都发生过，不把任何一种史论当成事实本身。

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画唐「永贞革新」（二王八司马），时间805 年，唐顺宗永贞元年。地点与格局：长安。人物：王叔文（翰林学士）、唐顺宗（唐帝）、柳宗元（礼部员外郎）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频只拍朝会里衣袖轻动、地图上的墨线缓缓延伸、仓廪与渠水几乎静止，镜头缓推后定格。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "永贞革新" (二王八司马) in the 唐 chapter, 805 年. Place and layout: Chang'an. Figures: Wang Shuwen, Emperor Shunzong, Liu Zongyuan. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video shows sleeves stirring in court, an ink line slowly extending across a map of reforms, granaries and canal water nearly still, then a slow push into a freeze-frame. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

scenes.title: 显德毁佛
scenes.subtitle: 周世宗
scenes.narrative: 显德二年，周世宗下令废除没有敕额的寺院，僧尼必须经过考试才能保留度牒，并把铜佛像销铸成钱。《旧五代史·世宗纪》和《五代会要》都记了。他的理由是国家缺铜、僧徒太滥，不是后来的思想运动。这一年和高平之战不是一件事：高平是用兵，这里是财政和寺观。本场画被封的寺门和铸钱的炉，不画战场。

sources.title: 旧五代史
sources.notes: 显德二年废无敕额寺院

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画五代十国「显德毁佛」（周世宗），时间955 年，后周显德二年。地点与格局：开封。人物：柴荣（后周世宗）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "显德毁佛" (周世宗) in the 五代十国 chapter, 955 年. Place and layout: Kaifeng. Figures: Chai Rong. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 更戍法
scenes.subtitle: 禁军轮驻

when.notes: 《宋史·兵志》说太祖立更戍法，没有系于某一天。

scenes.narrative: 宋太祖把精兵收到中央，让禁军定期换防，将领不固定带同一支兵，兵也不固定驻同一座城。《宋史·兵志》认为这是为了防止唐末藩镇的兵为将有。代价后来也很清楚：兵不识将，训练变差，一到对外战争就显出来。本场只画士卒出发换防的名册和空着的将旗，不把杯酒释兵权的宴会再演一遍。

sources.title: 宋史
sources.notes: 太祖惩藩镇之弊，立更戍法

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画北宋「更戍法」（禁军轮驻），时间约建隆年间，宋建隆中。地点与格局：汴京。人物：宋太祖（宋帝）、赵普（枢密使）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "更戍法" (禁军轮驻) in the 北宋 chapter, 约建隆年间. Place and layout: Bianjing. Figures: Emperor Taizu of Song, Zhao Pu. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画北宋「更戍法」（禁军轮驻），时间约建隆年间，宋建隆中。地点与格局：汴京。人物：宋太祖（宋帝）、赵普（枢密使）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "更戍法" (禁军轮驻) in the 北宋 chapter, 约建隆年间. Place and layout: Bianjing. Figures: Emperor Taizu of Song, Zhao Pu. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

scenes.title: 元祐更化
scenes.subtitle: 司马光
scenes.narrative: 神宗死，高太后听政，起用司马光。元祐元年，免役、青苗等新法被陆续罢掉，司马光在几个月里把他认为害民的条目改回去，自己也在这一年九月去世。苏轼等人并不是每一条都同意他的速度。《宋史·哲宗纪》和《司马光传》记录了改法本身。熙宁变法已有专场，本场是它的回摆：同一座朝堂，相反的诏书。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画北宋「元祐更化」（司马光），时间1086 年，宋元祐元年。地点与格局：汴京。人物：司马光（尚书左仆射）、高太后（太皇太后）、宋哲宗（宋帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "元祐更化" (司马光) in the 北宋 chapter, 1086 年. Place and layout: Bianjing. Figures: Sima Guang, Empress Dowager Gao, Emperor Zhezong. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画北宋「元祐更化」（司马光），时间1086 年，宋元祐元年。地点与格局：汴京。人物：司马光（尚书左仆射）、高太后（太皇太后）、宋哲宗（宋帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "元祐更化" (司马光) in the 北宋 chapter, 1086 年. Place and layout: Bianjing. Figures: Sima Guang, Empress Dowager Gao, Emperor Zhezong. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 三舍法
scenes.subtitle: 太学
scenes.narrative: 熙宁四年，王安石把太学分成外舍、内舍、上舍。学生按考试和行艺升舍，上舍上等可以免解甚至直接授官。《宋史·选举志》记了这个办法。它是想用学校代替一部分科举，后来在党争里屡次废复。本场不评价它是否成功，只画太学的三进院子和名榜。乌台诗案是另一场，不放进这间学堂。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画北宋「三舍法」（太学），时间1071 年，宋熙宁四年。地点与格局：汴京、太学。人物：王安石（参知政事）、宋神宗（宋帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "三舍法" (太学) in the 北宋 chapter, 1071 年. Place and layout: the Imperial Academy, Bianjing. Figures: Wang Anshi, Emperor Shenzong. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 绍兴和议
scenes.subtitle: 淮水为界

when.era: 宋绍兴十一年 · 金皇统元年

scenes.narrative: 绍兴十一年，宋金再定和议：宋称臣，岁贡银绢，两国以淮水中流、大散关为界，并割唐、邓。岳飞在这一年被杀，是和议的配套，已有“精忠”一场。本场只取边界和誓书：一张把淮河画成国界的地图，和朝堂上的岁币账。地理上的淮河另有专场可画水，这里画的是条约如何写成。

sources.title: 金史
sources.notes: 皇统元年宋称臣，画淮为界

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "绍兴和议" (淮水为界) in the 南宋 chapter, 1141 年. Place and layout: Lin'an and the Huai. Figures: Qin Hui, Emperor Gaozong, Wanyan Zongbi. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video shows sleeves stirring in court, an ink line slowly extending across a map of reforms, granaries and canal water nearly still, then a slow push into a freeze-frame. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

scenes.title: 经界法
scenes.subtitle: 李椿年
scenes.narrative: 和议刚签，李椿年请在平江开始经界：丈量田亩，造砧基簿，让产有主、税有地。绍兴十二年推行，后来扩到其他路，也因为扰民和豪强抵制时停时续。《宋史·食货志》记录了砧基簿的办法。这是南宋在半壁江山上重做土地账。本场画田埂、图帐和拒测的村庄，不画前线。

sources.title: 宋史
sources.notes: 绍兴十二年李椿年经界，造砧基簿

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画南宋「经界法」（李椿年），时间1142 年，宋绍兴十二年。地点与格局：平江。人物：李椿年（两浙转运副使）、宋高宗（宋帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "经界法" (李椿年) in the 南宋 chapter, 1142 年. Place and layout: Pingjiang. Figures: Li Chunnian, Emperor Gaozong. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画南宋「经界法」（李椿年），时间1142 年，宋绍兴十二年。地点与格局：平江。人物：李椿年（两浙转运副使）、宋高宗（宋帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "经界法" (李椿年) in the 南宋 chapter, 1142 年. Place and layout: Pingjiang. Figures: Li Chunnian, Emperor Gaozong. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

scenes.title: 南北面官
scenes.subtitle: 辽的两套政府

when.notes: 南北面官的定制有一个过程，《辽史·百官志》追述于太宗得燕云之后。会同十年与大同元年都在 947 年。

scenes.narrative: 辽朝用北面官治宫帐、部族和属国，用南面官治汉人州县，官名一套像契丹，一套像唐朝。《辽史·百官志》的序把这个设计说得很明确，具体设官的年份则是后来追记的。它是征服政权保留两套制度、而不是立刻改成单一汉制的例子。本场画同一座帐前的两排印信，不把契丹文字画成可读的汉字。

sources.title: 辽史

scenes.title: 猛安谋克
scenes.subtitle: 女真的军政单位
scenes.narrative: 女真起兵之前，阿骨打就把部人编成猛安、谋克：猛安相当于千户，谋克相当于百户，平时狩猎耕种，战时出兵。《金史·太祖纪》和《兵志》都写了这套编制在宁江州之战前后被用来扩军。它既是军队也是户籍。本场和护步答冈的会战分开，只画营帐和户册。南下中原以后，猛安谋克迁到华北屯田，是后来的问题，不在这一年。

sources.title: 金史
sources.notes: 天庆四年起兵，以猛安谋克统军

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画辽 · 西夏 · 金「猛安谋克」（女真的军政单位），时间1114 年，辽天庆四年。地点与格局：宁江州。人物：完颜阿骨打（女真都勃极烈）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "猛安谋克" (女真的军政单位) in the 辽 · 西夏 · 金 chapter, 1114 年. Place and layout: Ningjiang. Figures: Wanyan Aguda. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 行省
scenes.subtitle: 政令出中书

when.era: 元世祖至元十七年前后
when.notes: 行省从出征时的行中书省逐渐变成固定大区，年份取至元中叶，不假装有一天颁定全国。

scenes.narrative: 蒙古出征时派行中书省随军。忽必烈定都之后，这些行省慢慢变成固定的大行政区，掌一路的钱粮、兵甲和刑名，上面是中书省。《元史·百官志》记录了各行省的名称和职掌。这是中国地方制度里“省”的直接来源。本场画从大都伸向各路的墨线，不把行省当成清代的总督衙门。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画元「行省」（政令出中书），时间约至元中，元世祖至元十七年前后。地点与格局：大都。人物：忽必烈（元世祖）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "行省" (政令出中书) in the 元 chapter, 约至元中. Place and layout: Dadu. Figures: Kublai Khan. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画元「行省」（政令出中书），时间约至元中，元世祖至元十七年前后。地点与格局：大都。人物：忽必烈（元世祖）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频只拍朝会里衣袖轻动、地图上的墨线缓缓延伸、仓廪与渠水几乎静止，镜头缓推后定格。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "行省" (政令出中书) in the 元 chapter, 约至元中. Place and layout: Dadu. Figures: Kublai Khan. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video shows sleeves stirring in court, an ink line slowly extending across a map of reforms, granaries and canal water nearly still, then a slow push into a freeze-frame. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

scenes.title: 鱼鳞图册
scenes.subtitle: 洪武二十年
scenes.narrative: 洪武二十年，明朝在各地攒造鱼鳞图册，把每块田的形状、四至、业主画成相连的鱼鳞状图，和赋役黄册互相核对。《明史·食货志》说明黄册管户、鱼鳞图册管田。这是朱元璋在全国范围内重做土地底账。本场画一册打开的田图，不画胡惟庸案的朝堂——那是洪武十三年的另一场政治清洗。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画明「鱼鳞图册」（洪武二十年），时间1387 年，明洪武二十年。地点与格局：南京。人物：朱元璋（明太祖）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "鱼鳞图册" (洪武二十年) in the 明 chapter, 1387 年. Place and layout: Nanjing. Figures: Zhu Yuanzhang. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "鱼鳞图册" (洪武二十年) in the 明 chapter, 1387 年. Place and layout: Nanjing. Figures: Zhu Yuanzhang. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. scenes.title: 海禁
scenes.subtitle: 寸板不许下海

when.notes: 禁海诏令的年月各书详略不同，本场只取洪武初禁止私自出海这一政策，不锁定某一道诏的日子。

scenes.narrative: 洪武年间明朝禁止民间私造海船、私自下海通番，朝贡以外的海上贸易被当成犯罪。《明史·食货志》把海禁和后来的倭乱、市舶废置连在一起叙述。郑和的船队是朝贡体系里的例外，不是这道禁令的取消。本场画封住的海口和空着的市舶公案。具体哪一天第一道诏书发出，材料不一致，所以年份用约数。

sources.title: 明史
sources.notes: 洪武禁濒海民私通海外

sources.title: 明史

image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 永不加赋
scenes.subtitle: 康熙五十一年
scenes.narrative: 康熙五十一年，朝廷宣布以五十年的人丁数为定额，以后新生的人丁不再加征丁银，叫“盛世滋生人丁，永不加赋”。《清史稿·食货志》和《圣祖本纪》都有这条。它没有立刻取消丁银，只是把丁银总额冻结。真正把丁银摊进地亩，是雍正年间的另一步。本场只画冻结的丁额册，不把摊丁入亩提前算到这一年。

sources.title: 清史稿
sources.notes: 康熙五十一年滋生人丁永不加赋

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画清「永不加赋」（康熙五十一年），时间1712 年，清康熙五十一年。地点与格局：北京。人物：康熙帝（清帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "永不加赋" (康熙五十一年) in the 清 chapter, 1712 年. Place and layout: Beijing. Figures: Kangxi Emperor. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

negative.zh: 全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀）。不出现任何现代元素：现代建筑、电线、电线杆、公路、车辆、玻璃、塑料、现代服饰、眼镜、手表、枪械、电灯、招牌或文字标识。不出现时代错置之物：西式王冠、尖刺王冠、欧式王冠、礼帽、羽毛头饰、印第安羽冠、尖顶兜帽长袍、三K党兜帽、日本鸟居、日式建筑、武士刀、高速公路、柏油路、车道线、登山杖、双肩背包、徒步者、喷气式飞机、飞机、导弹、台灯、灯罩、灯泡、玻璃灯罩、玻璃窗、玻璃马车、欧式驿马车、美式篷车、招牌、带字匾额、旗上徽记、圆形徽章、标志、藏青色天空、蓝色调、青色、黄色、橙色
negative.en: full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana. no modern elements: no modern buildings, power lines, poles, roads, vehicles, glass, plastic, modern clothing, eyeglasses, watches, guns, electric lights, signs or lettering. no anachronisms: western crown, spiked crown, european crown, top hat, feather headdress, native american headdress, hooded robes, pointed hood, klan hood, torii, japanese architecture, katana, highway, asphalt road, lane markings, trekking poles, backpack, hikers, jet, aircraft, missile, table lamp, lampshade, light bulb, glass lamp chimney, glass windows, glazed carriage, stagecoach, conestoga covered wagon, signboard, plaque with characters, emblem on flag, circular emblem, logo, navy blue sky, blue tint, cyan, yellow, orange

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). music.zh: 配乐庄严，近于朝会：编钟与古琴，缓慢，五声音阶，没有歌词，不要战鼓喧哗。本场：清「永不加赋」。
music.en: Music is solemn and courtly: bells and qin, slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no battlefield drums. This cue: "永不加赋" in 清.

sound.zh: 声响以朝局为线：殿中回声、竹简展开、脚步在砖地上、远处市声。不要金戈与喊杀。本场地点：北京。
sound.en: Sound follows the court: hall reverb, bamboo slips unrolling, footsteps on brick, a distant market. No clash of arms, no war cries. Place for this cue: Beijing.

scenes.title: 改土归流
scenes.subtitle: 鄂尔泰
scenes.narrative: 西南土司世袭管地、管人。雍正四年，云贵总督鄂尔泰奏请在用兵能到的地方改设流官，雍正批准，云南、贵州、广西和四川的一部分土司被废。《清史稿·土司传》和《鄂尔泰传》写了推行，也写了乌蒙、古州等地的反抗和清军的镇压。这不是和平的行政更名。本场画土司印信被收走、流官的关防送进山寨，不回避镇压，也不把它画成现代的省界测绘。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画清「改土归流」（鄂尔泰），时间1726 年，清雍正四年。地点与格局：云南、贵州。人物：鄂尔泰（云贵总督）、雍正帝（清帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "改土归流" (鄂尔泰) in the 清 chapter, 1726 年. Place and layout: Yunnan and Guizhou. Figures: Ortai, Yongzheng Emperor. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 军机处
scenes.subtitle: 雍正七年
scenes.narrative: 雍正七年，因为对准噶尔用兵，宫里设立军机房，让亲信大臣值宿，承旨出诏，后来改名军机处，战争结束后也没有撤。《清史稿·军机大臣年表》从这一年开始列名。它使许多机要不再经过内阁的票拟。本场画隆宗门内的值房和一封未封口的廷寄，不把军机处写成后来一切决策的唯一地点——有些事仍然在皇帝和个别大臣之间。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画清「军机处」（雍正七年），时间1729 年，清雍正七年。地点与格局：北京、隆宗门。人物：雍正帝（清帝）、张廷玉（军机大臣）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "军机处" (雍正七年) in the 清 chapter, 1729 年. Place and layout: Beijing, the Grand Council office. Figures: Yongzheng Emperor, Zhang Tingyu. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

negative.zh: 全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀）。不出现任何现代元素：现代建筑、电线、电线杆、公路、车辆、玻璃、塑料、现代服饰、眼镜、手表、枪械、电灯、招牌或文字标识。不出现时代错置之物：西式王冠、尖刺王冠、欧式王冠、礼帽、羽毛头饰、印第安羽冠、尖顶兜帽长袍、三K党兜帽、日本鸟居、日式建筑、武士刀、高速公路、柏油路、车道线、登山杖、双肩背包、徒步者、喷气式飞机、飞机、导弹、台灯、灯罩、灯泡、玻璃灯罩、玻璃窗、玻璃马车、欧式驿马车、美式篷车、招牌、带字匾额、旗上徽记、圆形徽章、标志、藏青色天空、蓝色调、青色、黄色、橙色

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "军机处" (雍正七年) in the 清 chapter, 1729 年. Place and layout: Beijing, the Grand Council office. Figures: Yongzheng Emperor, Zhang Tingyu. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video shows sleeves stirring in court, an ink line slowly extending across a map of reforms, granaries and canal water nearly still, then a slow push into a freeze-frame. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

music.zh: 配乐庄严，近于朝会：编钟与古琴，缓慢，五声音阶，没有歌词，不要战鼓喧哗。本场：清「军机处」。
music.en: Music is solemn and courtly: bells and qin, slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no battlefield drums. This cue: "军机处" in 清.

sound.zh: 声响以朝局为线：殿中回声、竹简展开、脚步在砖地上、远处市声。不要金戈与喊杀。本场地点：北京、隆宗门。
sound.en: Sound follows the court: hall reverb, bamboo slips unrolling, footsteps on brick, a distant market. No clash of arms, no war cries. Place for this cue: Beijing, the Grand Council office.
